notes: v26: self-E2E J-series journey suite — the app now tests itself. Eight Robolectric journeys launch real app screens (MainActivity, feed, PDP, search) against an in-memory Room database and a MockWebServer feed, driving the real production trigger paths (cold start, pull-to-refresh, like/save) and real WorkManager workers: B1 like-state syncs to server records, B2 search likes persist across queries, B3 PDP hero image dedupes, B4 startup renders local articles before any shard byte lands (local-first ordering), B5 partial tag-backfill heals per shard without wedging the done flag, B6 pull-to-refresh swaps to unseen items with an honest outcome toast and never a premature queued toast. Harness resets WorkManager per test so each journey's workers bind to its own isolated Application/SharedPreferences/database. No user-facing changes.
